meta.note: Report-native sample base, survey-estimated weighting totals and relative standard errors. Estimated population totals are used for rates/ratios only; the report cautions against interpreting these totals in absolute terms. Person includes transgender respondents; male and female alone may not sum to Person. Dash denotes no sample. RSE is relative sampling error in percent, not a coverage percentage.
